name: Thal
title: Sentinel of the Evenway
examine: Old blood, whole, and younger than the other sentinels, which still makes him older than every road in the Dawnlands. He is the only Evenguard who asks travelers questions back.
lines: What is it like, the ford town? I have heard the bell. On a north wind, once, I heard the bell.
The king opened the gate. Some of us think a hundred and fifty years was hasty. I think it was about time. Do not repeat that.
Walk the stones and you will not be lost. Leave the stones and you will be lost exactly once.
